title: The danger of early pride
coreMove: Keep early signals provisional so they do not harden into an identity that refuses development.
sourcePressure: Aspire section: premature identity inflation before development is stable. Supported by frozen source sidecar.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Confusing earned confidence with premature pride, or treating every good sign as dangerous.
sourceAnchorNote: No named person, study, place, or artifact is available in the frozen source sidecar for this chapter; use fictional scenarios only and do not invent source anecdotes.
